description: Calculate a weighted GPA from courses (grade, credits, weight regular/honors/ap/ib), optionally resolved against a grading system in the database using the real band logic.

grade.description: Letter grade, percentage, or a grade label from the grading system

grading_system_id.description: grading_systems id whose bands resolve course grades

scale.description: Scale to report the GPA on (default 4.0)

name: calculate_gpa
